goal: Allow test tools to generate blocks with multiple custom coinbase payouts without external block builders
Let callers omit outputs to burn via OP_RETURN or omit transactions to assemble blocks directly from mempool
agreement: Substantive support for enabling multi-recipient coinbase payout simulation (supertestnet)
Past objections on scope, compatibility, and core miner modifications were addressed
Open suggestion to require at least one output address or descriptor (achow101)
Open suggestion to split optional argument handling into a separate PR (maflcko)
Pending feedback on author proposal to toggle automatic remainder reward splitting (andrewtoth)

categories.name: mining
why: P3 because it expands block generation tooling to simulate complex multi-recipient coinbase structures
Eases testing of mining pools that distribute payouts directly from coinbases

why: P3 because it adds flexible multi-output payout formatting to generateblock without breaking callers
Fills an RPC gap for regtest tooling and pool simulators
